== Acquisition ==
Part of [[Togo (disguise)|Togo's]] replacement [[skill bar]] during [[The Tengu Accords]] mission.

== Related skills ==
* {{skill icon|Signet of Spirits}} ([[elite]]) 

== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Anger]], [[Spirit of Hate]], and [[Spirit of Suffering]]. These spirits use the [[Pain (attack) (Togo)|Pain attack skill]].
* Although linked to the [[Channeling Magic]], this skill does not depend on the [[attribute]] rank. However, this rank (normally 14, but it may change from 13 to 15) affects the damage from the spirits' attacks.

== Trivia ==
* The three spirits are a reference to a quote made by [[w:Yoda|Yoda]] from Star Wars: "Anger leads to hate, hate leads to suffering." [[Linsey Murdock]] has [http://wiki.guildwars.com/index.php?title=User_talk:Linsey_Murdock&diff=1620226&oldid=1620209#Clarification.2C_we_need. stated] that [[Colin Johanson]] chose those spirit names and has confirmed that it is a reference to the Star Wars quote.
